project.name: NYC In Focus Platform
project.vision: A three-panel New York City platform combining a live event map, geo-verified ZIP Code community chat, and the NYC In Focus editorial story feed.
project.currentMilestone: Canonical Milestone 6 — GPS Pipeline Reliability and Identity Integrity
project.currentState: Milestones 1–5 complete. Milestone 6 implementation is complete on PR #143 and awaiting separate review and merge.
project.nextDecision: Review and merge PR #143, then authorize Milestone 7 identity consolidation and duplicate-key enforcement.
project.mobileGoal: Launch one cross-platform application on the Apple App Store and Google Play after the backend, API, trust-and-safety, privacy, and store-readiness milestones pass.

productPillars.name: Center — Live NYC Map
productPillars.summary: All approved events and city activity on an interactive map with filters, event details, directions, significance badges, and links into local discussion and reporting.
keyFeatures: links to ZIP chat and NYCIF stories

productPillars.name: Left — Geo-Verified ZIP Chat
productPillars.summary: Five-borough and ZIP Code rooms that anyone may read, while only users currently verified inside the geographic boundary may post.
keyFeatures: report, block, mute, moderation, and audit controls

productPillars.name: Right — NYC In Focus Story Feed
productPillars.summary: A visual editorial feed for NYC In Focus reporting, galleries, videos, civic coverage, and event stories, with direct links back to the map and local rooms.
keyFeatures: clear separation between NYCIF reporting, community reports, and sponsorships

interactionModel.navigation: The map is the central home screen. Press-and-hold circular left and right arrow controls, plus horizontal swipe gestures, move between chat, map, and stories while reducing accidental navigation.
interactionModel.notifications: Users can independently enable or disable notifications for ZIP chat, boroughs, event categories, major-event tiers, breaking coverage, saved events, and NYCIF stories.
interactionModel.locationPolicy: Precise location is requested only when a user attempts to join a local conversation. Browsing remains available without precise location. Background location is not required for the initial release.
interactionModel.privacyRule: Other users never see exact coordinates, home address, movement history, or precise distance. The visible state is only a time-limited location-verified eligibility badge.

integrityRules: users may view why an event received its tier

milestones.name: Foundation and governance
milestones.objective: Establish repository controls, evidence standards, review boundaries, and protected production paths.

milestones.name: Fixture and registry validation
milestones.objective: Prove deterministic fixture-only processing and stable review boundaries.

milestones.name: Credential and network-control closure
milestones.objective: Close secret-handling risks and establish process-level network isolation evidence.

milestones.name: Isolated validation execution
milestones.objective: Run authorized fixture validation in a network-denied, minimal environment with integrity proof.

milestones.name: Dependency reproducibility and workflow hardening
milestones.objective: Pin dependencies, harden commit conditions, enforce fail-closed email behavior, add offline tests, and document closure.

milestones.name: GPS pipeline reliability and identity integrity
milestones.objective: Document identity systems, add identity-drift and transition tests, and verify gating without modifying implementation.
milestones.evidence: PR #143 open; 16 new tests; 110 total tests reported passing under isolation.

milestones.name: Identity consolidation and duplicate enforcement
milestones.objective: Create one shared normalization and identity implementation, add explicit duplicate-key signaling, and deprecate unsafe positional review artifacts.

milestones.name: App-facing API and event-significance service
milestones.objective: Expose versioned event, nearby, category, borough, article, and significance endpoints with pagination, caching, errors, and rate limits.

milestones.name: Accounts, location verification, and ZIP-room authorization
milestones.objective: Build authentication, privacy-preserving geofence checks, short-lived posting eligibility, and ZIP room access rules.

milestones.name: Real-time chat and trust-and-safety
milestones.objective: Build messaging, media controls, moderation, reports, blocking, rate limits, audit logs, and community-report labeling.

milestones.name: Three-panel cross-platform application
milestones.objective: Build the center map, left chat, right story feed, press-and-hold navigation, accessibility, device layouts, and deep links for iOS and Android.

milestones.name: Notifications and personalization
milestones.objective: Add opt-in notification controls for ZIP rooms, boroughs, categories, significance tiers, saved events, and NYCIF stories.

milestones.name: Editorial feed and WordPress integration
milestones.objective: Connect NYCIF stories, galleries, video, map pins, and local rooms while preserving editorial and sponsorship labeling.

milestones.name: App-store privacy, safety, testing, and launch
milestones.objective: Complete privacy disclosures, permission flows, moderation readiness, TestFlight/Play testing, accessibility, store assets, and review submissions.

milestones.name: Revenue and growth
milestones.objective: Introduce clearly labeled sponsorships, promoted event tools, ticket affiliates, premium alerts, memberships, business products, and partner API licensing without compromising editorial trust.

nonNegotiableRules: No organizer may buy a Gold, Silver, or Bronze significance tier.
Community reports must be labeled as unverified until independently confirmed.
Precise user coordinates are never exposed to other users.
Posting authorization is decided server-side and expires.
Location permission is requested contextually, not at first launch.
Moderation, reporting, blocking, and contact mechanisms are launch requirements.
No milestone automatically authorizes the next milestone, production launch, or app-store submission.
